facts.fact: Comscore leverages passively-collected linear television viewing information from 60 million televisions, according to Comscore's own description in the partnership announcement.
facts.quote: Comscore leverages passively-collected linear television viewing information from 60 million televisions, in more than 30 million homes nationwide

facts.fact: Comscore's linear TV viewing data covers more than 30 million homes nationwide, per Comscore's own claim.
facts.quote: in more than 30 million homes nationwide, covering 99% of all US zip codes

facts.fact: The partnership between StackAdapt and Comscore was announced on 26 May 2020 to enable programmatic retargeting of linear TV viewers.
StackAdapt's Michael Shang says the retargeting solution is specifically ideal for political campaigns because significant budgets are often allocated to linear TV buys.
facts.quote: specifically ideal for political campaigns, as significant budgets are often allocated to linear TV buys
